description: Hello! We are an ambitious team participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge, focused on building innovative tech solutions. Our interests include programming, AI, and web development. We are looking for creative and driven members who want to collaborate on an impactful project. Join us to turn bold ideas into reality!
summary:
Beyond is an educational space exploration game developed in Unity. It takes players on a scientific journey through three unique biomes: tropical, desert, and taiga environments.
The main concept revolves around Cladosporium sphaerospermum, a radiation-resistant fungus with potential applications in space exploration. Players explore unfamiliar environments, conduct interactive experiments, collect scientific information, and investigate the organism's properties.
Beyond combines scientific education, immersive exploration, and engaging gameplay. Its intuitive interface makes the experience accessible to curious players, encouraging them to discover the connections between biology, technology, and the future of space exploration.
Our goal is to transform complex scientific concepts into an interactive adventure that inspires curiosity about life beyond Earth.
details:
Beyond is an educational space exploration game developed using Unity. The project explores the potential of biological organisms in future space missions, focusing on the radiation-resistant fungus Cladosporium sphaerospermum.

The player explores three distinct environments: Tropical, Sand, and Taiga. Each biome provides a unique atmosphere and opportunities for scientific exploration.

The main gameplay revolves around discovering unfamiliar environments, conducting interactive experiments, collecting information, and understanding the properties of the organism.

The game features an intuitive interface, immersive environments, and a central space station that connects the different biomes. Environmental storytelling and scientific discoveries encourage players to explore further.

Our project aims to make scientific concepts more accessible through interactive entertainment while raising awareness of biological research and its possible applications in space exploration.

Technologies: Unity, C#, 3D modelling, game development tools, and digital visual design.
